title: The Bloop: The Mysterious Sound Beneath the Pacific
description: In 1997, underwater microphones recorded an extremely powerful low-frequency sound across the Pacific. Scientists later concluded it was consistent with ice-related seismic activity, rather than an unknown sea creature.
